annotations.title: Set LinkedIn profile targeting on a Microsoft Advertising campaign

description: Target LinkedIn profiles on a Microsoft Advertising Search, Shopping or Dynamic Search Ads campaign: add companies, industries, job functions, seniorities or job titles, each with an optional bid adjustment (whole percent, -90 to 900), or change an existing adjustment by criterion id (list_microsoft_ads_profile_targeting shows it). Find profile ids with search_microsoft_ads_profiles. On an ACTIVE campaign this changes bids on the very next auction, so show the user the changes, get an explicit yes, then call with confirm:true. The reply is what Microsoft reads back, and a change that does not read back is named. Removing a profile criterion is not available here; an adjustment of 0 has no effect on bids.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

add.description: profile criteria to add: [{profileType, profileId, bidAdjustment}]

bidAdjustment.description: whole percent, -90 to 900; omit for none

profileId.description: profile id from search_microsoft_ads_profiles; job title and seniority ids are passed as-is

profileType.description: type of the profileId: CompanyName, Industry, JobFunction, JobSeniority or JobTitle

campaignId.description: Microsoft campaign id to change LinkedIn profile targeting on

confirm.description: REQUIRED true when the campaign is ACTIVE

update.description: bid adjustments to change on existing criteria: [{criterionId, bidAdjustment}]

name: set_microsoft_ads_profile_targeting
title: Set LinkedIn profile targeting on a Microsoft Advertising campaign
